project.name: Unc-ModelValidator (reserved)
project.description: Reserved slot for this thesis's actual contribution: an uncertainty-aware bounded model finder/validator, supporting the four U-types (UReal/UInteger/UBoolean/UString) alongside crisp OCL, evaluated in part against kk-modelvalidator on the crisp fragment both can express. Named "unc" (uncertain) rather than "z3" deliberately: Z3 is the pinned first backend (proposal Sec.6, z3-4.16.0), but the module name should not preclude a different or additional SMT backend later without another rename. Not started -- see output/milestone1_fastpath_prompt.md and output/PROGRAM_ROADMAP.md Phase 1 for the actual Track R work graph. Left as packaging=pom with no source until that work begins; switches to a real jar module then.
